from typing import List, Optional
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, ConfigDict

class SearchResultsOutputModel(BaseModel):
    search_results: List[Dict] = Field(
        default=None, description="List of search results."
    )
    query_summary: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None, description="Response to customer."
    )
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

# Retrieve cached flight search results
prior_results = get_results_from_cache(key="departure_flights")

# Define flight search parameters based on user input and cache
start_airport_city = "San Jose"
end_airport_city = "San Antonio"
departure_date = ["May 18, 2025", "May 21, 2025"]
flight_class = ["first"]
num_layovers = [0]  # Assuming direct flights preferred unless specified otherwise

# Perform flight search
search_results = search_flights(
    start_airport_city=start_airport_city,
    end_airport_city=end_airport_city,
    departure_date=departure_date,
    flight_class=flight_class,
    num_layovers=num_layovers
)

# Save search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="departure_flights", value=search_results)

# Filter flights based on user's preferred class and date
filtered_results = filter_flights(
    prior_results=prior_results,
    flight_class=flight_class,
    departure_date=departure_date
)

# Save filtered results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_departure_flights", value=filtered_results)

# Sort results by first class price (descending)
sorted_results = sort_results(
    results=filtered_results,
    column="first_class_price",
    ascending=False
)

# Save sorted results to cache
save_to_cache(key="sorted_departure_flights", value=sorted_results)

# Output summary
print("No planning needed")
